description: Find and replace panel (redesign 146c7e1b, phase 6, DE-2.3, decision DE2): the inspector's context on a desktop layout and the body of a floating panel on a tablet or a phone. A labelled search field with the count inside it and a clear button, previous / next arrows, the options as a column, the scope on the full width, a Replace toggle (the replace field and a primary Replace / secondary Replace all), and 'Results (N)' as cards with the match marked in its sentence (ContextBefore / ContextAfter of DocumentSearchResult). The search is debounced (200 ms); Enter / Shift+Enter navigate and Escape closes.

parameters.name: OnNavigateRequested
parameters.description: R.4.8 — raised on next(+1)/previous(-1) navigation for host-driven highlight.

parameters.name: ShowHeader
parameters.description: Whether the panel renders its own header (the title and the X). The editor passes false because its host already has one.
